The13November actual ETH/ZZZ contribution profile captures retain controlled feed/depth and20M gas scope, without mainnet fees/markets.

Individual file hash matches below do not imply full dependency closure unchanged after current state.py hardening; new state behavior has its own focused review/evidence.
remaining_boundaries: Provider responses/indexer complete history are trusted observations checked against pinned code/anchors, not a consensus or log completeness proof.
Price-source economic independence, usable bidirectional depth and complete target network fees remain external release gates.
Optional checkpoint source pins, maximum lifetime/history/max-state throughput, full hosted multiclient operation and fresh deployment adoption remain separate qualification.
Original-currency royalty availability depends on admitted token behavior; no universal payout for arbitrary malicious/unreadable tokens.
Unsigned current-contract profiles remain unsigned; wallet confirmation/recovery is outside these preparation readers.
The imported helper inventory and declared function list are evidence indexes; this manual pass does not establish path-complete or formal correctness.
